meta.name: Crime Beat
meta.description:
Small-town crime journalist Abhishek finds his life and career affected by a fugitive gangster. As he gets trapped in a web of lies and motives, what price will he pay- to become a renowned reporter?

Rated U/A 16+ · Ended · First aired 21 Feb 2025 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Content Films Production · Network: ZEE5

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: The How What and Why
videos.overview: Delhi's notorious mafia don, Binny Chaudhary, returns to the city and is killed in front of a large crowd. Rookie crime reporter Abhishek Sinha investigates the don's life for his next big story.

videos.title: Master of Disguise
videos.overview: Amir Akhtar meets DCP Uday for information on Binny. Abhishek learns of Binny’s mysterious associate known as 'Heroine'. He investigates on his own after Amir restricts his involvement in the case.

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Abhishek is caught sneaking into Binny’s mansion. On the other hand, Binny escapes CBI-Interpol with the help of an Iranian tribe. ACP Mayank finds a crucial clue about ‘Heroine’.

videos.title: The Homecoming
videos.overview: Binny secretly arrives in Mumbai instead of Delhi, alarming DCP Uday and Rawat. His return raises concerns for ‘Heroine'. Meanwhile, Abhishek continues to struggle for a spot on the front page.

videos.title: Karne Kaun Dega
videos.overview: ACP Mayank tracks down ‘Heroine’ with Abhishek's tip, leading to a shootout where Salim gets killed. DCP Uday rebukes Mayank for the operation and reveals a shocking truth about his martyr father.

videos.title: Main Lakshya Hoon Tera
videos.overview: Abhishek leaves Amir’s firm and struggles to find work. Later, with senior photographer Pashupati’s help, Abhishek lands a job at a major newspaper. Later, he comes face to face with Binny Chaudhary.

videos.title: Khiladi, Katputli aur Khel
videos.overview: Heroine' takes Abhishek to Binny, who gives him a video of businessman Mahajan’s confession. Abhishek interviews Binny, while CBI tracks them down on Minister Rawat’s orders to execute Binny.

videos.title: The New Ringmaster
videos.overview: Maya gets kidnapped by Binny’s men and is stunned to learn about her father's involvement in the CWG scam. ACP Mayank arrives with the CBI but is forced to retreat. Binny plays his last card.
